svg.title: The deep: Deep-sea naturalist lithograph
svg.desc: The Deep (2D): Alexi swims down through four light bands toward a sunken tender, carried by a current he stirs as a glowing ribbon. Company chains hang from the pilings as a sweeping hazard, glowing specimens drift past, and the screen edge darkens with the pull of the deep. The depth gauge in the margin reads his depth; the pale ring marks the strongbox in the wreck.
